title: Signing and verifying requests
description:
Implement the signing scheme described in lesson 2.04, exactly as defined here, for both the client (signing) and the server (verifying).

```python
def canonical_string(method, path, query, timestamp, body): ...
def sign(secret, method, path, query, body, timestamp): ...
def verify(secret, method, path, query, body, headers, now, tolerance=300): ...
```

`secret` is `bytes`; `query` is a list of `(name, value)` string pairs (names may repeat); `body` is `bytes` or `None`.

**The canonical string** is five lines joined with `\n`, with no newline at the end:

1. the method in upper case;
2. the path as given;
3. the query pairs **sorted** by name and then by value, each written `name=value` with both escaped by `quote(..., safe="-_.~")`, joined with `&` (an empty line if there are none);
4. the timestamp as a decimal integer;
5. the SHA-256 of the body in lower-case hex (`None` counts as no bytes).

**sign** returns the headers to send: `{"X-Timestamp": "<timestamp>", "X-Signature": "<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical string, keyed with secret>"}`.

**verify** is the server's check. It returns `False` if either header is missing (header names are matched ignoring case), if `X-Timestamp` is not a whole number, if it is more than `tolerance` seconds away from `now` in either direction, or if the signature does not match (compare with `hmac.compare_digest`). Otherwise it returns `True`.
hints: `sorted(query)` sorts the pairs by name and then by value, because tuples compare item by item.
In `verify`, rebuild the canonical string from the request **as received** and the timestamp from its header, sign it yourself, and compare.
unitTests:
SECRET = b"topsecret"
QUERY = [("tag", "sf"), ("a", "1"), ("tag", "x y")]
BODY = b'{"title":"Dune"}'

@test("the canonical string")
def _():
    check_eq(canonical_string("post", "/v1/books", QUERY, 1793523600, BODY),
             "POST\n/v1/books\na=1&tag=sf&tag=x%20y\n1793523600\n122d1d2c5d0d60975f44dbb27133c6193af8ee5d379357a58add410f55673def")
    check_eq(canonical_string("GET", "/", [], 5, None),
             "GET\n/\n\n5\ne3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855")

@test("a known signature")
def _():
    check_eq(sign(SECRET, "post", "/v1/books", QUERY, BODY, 1793523600),
             {"X-Timestamp": "1793523600", "X-Signature": "0e8676d70e3bc22732da076dd40f27e82af7ff26740dff25824d46c7dec19c6b"})

@test("signing and verifying")
def _():
    h = sign(SECRET, "POST", "/v1/books", QUERY, BODY, 1000)
    check(verify(SECRET, "POST", "/v1/books", QUERY, BODY, h, now=1000))
    check(verify(SECRET, "post", "/v1/books", list(reversed(QUERY)), BODY, h, now=1200))
    lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in h.items()}
    check(verify(SECRET, "POST", "/v1/books", QUERY, BODY, lower, now=1000))

@test("any change breaks it")
def _():
    h = sign(SECRET, "POST", "/v1/books", QUERY, BODY, 1000)
    check(not verify(SECRET, "PUT", "/v1/books", QUERY, BODY, h, now=1000))
    check(not verify(SECRET, "POST", "/v1/book", QUERY, BODY, h, now=1000))
    check(not verify(SECRET, "POST", "/v1/books", QUERY[:2], BODY, h, now=1000))
    check(not verify(SECRET, "POST", "/v1/books", QUERY, BODY + b" ", h, now=1000))
    check(not verify(b"other", "POST", "/v1/books", QUERY, BODY, h, now=1000))
    bad = h["X-Signature"][:-1] + ("1" if h["X-Signature"][-1] != "1" else "2")
    check(not verify(SECRET, "POST", "/v1/books", QUERY, BODY, {**h, "X-Signature": bad}, now=1000))

@test("time and missing headers")
def _():
    h = sign(SECRET, "GET", "/x", [], None, 1000)
    check(verify(SECRET, "GET", "/x", [], None, h, now=1300))
    check(not verify(SECRET, "GET", "/x", [], None, h, now=1301))
    check(verify(SECRET, "GET", "/x", [], None, h, now=700))
    check(not verify(SECRET, "GET", "/x", [], None, h, now=699))
    check(verify(SECRET, "GET", "/x", [], None, h, now=1060, tolerance=60))
    check(not verify(SECRET, "GET", "/x", [], None, {"X-Signature": h["X-Signature"]}, now=1000))
    check(not verify(SECRET, "GET", "/x", [], None, {"X-Timestamp": "1000"}, now=1000))
    check(not verify(SECRET, "GET", "/x", [], None, {**h, "X-Timestamp": "10e2"}, now=1000))
